rules.statement: A purchaser who could have completed his title by prescriptive possession but has not done so and thereby suffers eviction is not entitled to sue for recovery of the purchase price and damages.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am therefore of opinion that any action, whatever its form may be, where the validity of the title conveyed comes up for determination and decision against such title is given, a cause of action for breach of warranty will arise, provided, of course, the vendor had been duly noticed to warrant and defend the title conveyed by him."
